Mexico defeats Ecuador in World Cup match, advances to Round of 16

Mexico has advanced to the Round of 16 of the FIFA World Cup after defeating Ecuador 2-0. The match was reportedly delayed by a storm in Mexico City. Mexican fans were also reported to have disturbed Ecuador's team hotel the night before the game, leading to a formal complaint.
